starts: Same twelve ordinary open-play starts in fresh processes. Alternating challenger colors. Only goal or ball-out restarts.
demo_starts: One new contested midfield start, then one ordinary open-play start; full 90 seconds each.
contest: Opposing mouths simultaneously contain the ball for at least 0.20 s. Re-arm after 0.20 s exclusive possession, a referee restart, or 1 s without a mouth on the ball.
chain: A contestant establishes exclusive mouth control for 0.20 s within 3 s of leaving the tie, then physically kicks to the selected teammate within 8 s of recovery; no opposing mouth touch, intervening kick or reset before delivery. Reception requires 0.55 m travel and 0.20 s exclusive possession within 4 s.
